messages.subject: RFQ Pump shaft HX (part:320070) – complete packages for 4200 pc/year, 24 months
messages.body:
Dear Mr Dralveck,

Thank you for your quote. We value you as a partner and would like to make this work.

The stainless bar index fell from 3182.6744 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06) to 3007.8019 (idx:AS-14404@2026-09), a change of -5.49%.
The PPI-D351 energy index fell from 140.5 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-11) to 123.7 (idx:PPI-D351@2026-04), a change of -11.96%.
We hold a current rival offer at EUR 33.00 per unit (offer:70240-1-a).

We propose the attached complete packages for 4200 pc per year over 24 months, DAP, no tooling. Is there a cheaper machining or material variant you could suggest? What is your earliest lead time?

Kind regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: RFQ Pump shaft HX (part:320070) – complete packages for 4200 pc/year, 24 months
messages.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. Your data on the material and energy indexes is spot on, so I am dropping the price to €31.00. 

We are a small shop and need the cash to keep the machines running, so I must insist on 30 days payment. We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price. Our earliest lead time is 28 days, and I will have the guys check if there is a cheaper way to machine this. From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 1.10 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.82 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.51 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision. With overtime we can deliver in 28 days, at a premium. We have free capacity for your parts. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C2431, AS-14404, PPI-D351. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. Our Lieferzeit is 35 days.

Our current offer is a price of €31.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days.

As an alternative, at our standard terms, we can offer a price of €31.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days. Alternatively, with Lieferzeit 28 days: €31.00 per unit.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH
